subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should yielded-parent waiting become a permanent public deferred cron/protocol/plugin status, or remain an internal lifecycle state exposed through backward-compatible diagnostics or metadata?
rationale: The bug fix is necessary, but the proposed status, callback, SDK helpers, and hook fields create long-lived persisted and external compatibility contracts that implementation evidence alone cannot settle.

options.title: Keep waiting internal
options.body: Preserve existing public status unions and represent yielded-parent waiting through additive diagnostics or metadata while retaining the corrected settlement behavior.

options.title: Adopt public deferred
options.body: Accept deferred as a supported public contract and require explicit fresh-install, upgrade, mixed-version, CLI, UI, and plugin compatibility proof.

options.title: Pause for consolidation
options.body: Hold this PR until overlapping yielded-session and cron-orchestration work has one canonical maintainer-owned lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Keep waiting internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public status unions and represent yielded-parent waiting through additive diagnostics or metadata while retaining the corrected settlement behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository-wide product and compatibility decision spans persisted cron state, Gateway protocol, plugin SDK, CLI, UI, and Discord behavior.
